question: At system scale, what does a complete collection system inventory provide the base for?
correctAnswer: Planning cleaning, inspection and renewal work across all sewersheds
explanation: An inventory of pipes, manholes and stations, with size, age and material, lets managers plan cleaning, inspection and renewal across the whole system.
options: Recording which crew responded to the most recent customer complaint call
Planning cleaning, inspection and renewal work across all sewersheds
Counting the number of vehicles available for winter standby coverage
Listing the chemicals stored at the largest lift station in the system
optionA: Recording which crew responded to the most recent customer complaint call
optionB: Planning cleaning, inspection and renewal work across all sewersheds
optionC: Counting the number of vehicles available for winter standby coverage
optionD: Listing the chemicals stored at the largest lift station in the system

That all maintenance staff hold the same class of operator certificate

That sewer use charges cover the full cost of the renewal program

question: How does inflow differ from infiltration in a sanitary sewer system?
correctAnswer: Inflow enters through direct surface connections, while infiltration seeps in below ground
explanation: Inflow is surface water entering through connections such as roof leaders and cross connections. Infiltration is groundwater entering through defects below ground.
options: Inflow enters through direct surface connections, while infiltration seeps in below ground
Inflow is measured at night, while infiltration is measured during the daytime hours in the field
Inflow comes from industrial users, while infiltration comes from residential areas
Inflow travels in storm sewers, while infiltration travels in sanitary forcemains
optionA: Inflow enters through direct surface connections, while infiltration seeps in below ground
optionB: Inflow is measured at night, while infiltration is measured during the daytime hours in the field
optionC: Inflow comes from industrial users, while infiltration comes from residential areas
optionD: Inflow travels in storm sewers, while infiltration travels in sanitary forcemains
sourceTitle: US EPA — CMOM Guide for Sanitary Sewer Collection Systems

question: What does the term RDII mean in collection system flow analysis?
correctAnswer: Rainfall dependent infiltration and inflow

Rainfall duration intensity index
Residual dry weather infiltration inflow
Rainfall dependent infiltration and inflow

optionB: Rainfall duration intensity index
optionC: Residual dry weather infiltration inflow
optionD: Rainfall dependent infiltration and inflow

question: Why are combination air valves installed at high points along a force main?
correctAnswer: To release accumulated air that reduces flow area and raises pumping head
explanation: Air collects at high points, reduces the effective flow area and increases head loss. Air valves release that air and admit air during draining to protect the main.
options: To release accumulated air that reduces flow area and raises pumping head
To sample wastewater quality at regular intervals along the pipeline route
To add oxygen to the wastewater so odours stay low at the discharge point
To drain the force main quickly whenever the pumps are taken offline
optionA: To release accumulated air that reduces flow area and raises pumping head
optionB: To sample wastewater quality at regular intervals along the pipeline route
optionC: To add oxygen to the wastewater so odours stay low at the discharge point
optionD: To drain the force main quickly whenever the pumps are taken offline

question: A flow monitor shows flow rising during a storm, peaking about two hours after the rain ends, then falling slowly over two days. What does this pattern suggest?
correctAnswer: A large slow response component, consistent with groundwater infiltration entering after the storm
explanation: A delayed peak and a long, slow recession point to rainfall driven groundwater infiltration rather than fast direct inflow, which tracks the rain closely.
options: A direct inflow response only, because direct inflow usually peaks well after rainfall ends
A large slow response component, consistent with groundwater infiltration entering after the storm
A meter error, because wet weather flow in a sanitary sewer cannot stay elevated for two days
A pump station influence, because gravity sewer flow patterns are set by pump run times
optionA: A direct inflow response only, because direct inflow usually peaks well after rainfall ends
optionB: A large slow response component, consistent with groundwater infiltration entering after the storm
optionC: A meter error, because wet weather flow in a sanitary sewer cannot stay elevated for two days
optionD: A pump station influence, because gravity sewer flow patterns are set by pump run times

The age of the standby generator battery and its last load test record
The calibration certificate for the flow meter at the treatment plant

question: Odour complaints cluster at the manhole where a long force main discharges to a gravity sewer. What is the most likely cause to investigate?
correctAnswer: Sulfide built up during long detention in the force main, released at the discharge
explanation: Long force main detention turns wastewater septic and generates sulfide, which is released as hydrogen sulfide gas where the flow becomes turbulent at discharge.
options: Excess dissolved oxygen carried over from the wet well into the force main flow
Cold wastewater temperatures slowing the biological activity in the gravity sewer
Sulfide built up during long detention in the force main, released at the discharge
High grit loads scouring the gravity sewer and exposing fresh concrete surfaces
optionA: Excess dissolved oxygen carried over from the wet well into the force main flow
optionB: Cold wastewater temperatures slowing the biological activity in the gravity sewer
optionC: Sulfide built up during long detention in the force main, released at the discharge
optionD: High grit loads scouring the gravity sewer and exposing fresh concrete surfaces
